title: Had an airport dream this night that I managed to remember and write down.
content: I dreamed I was in an airport with 2 pieces of luggage and I was taking some weird snowmobile/bus thing that was boarding from the road that reaches the front of the airport. I had to take an elevator a few floors down to the boarding area and 2 people I knew from school were behind me so I assumed if I put my luggage on the elevator and just left, they would know to take my luggage to the boarding area. So I put my luggage in the elevator, and left for the boarding area myself (not using that elevator), without even asking them to carry my luggage for me (I didn't say a word to them in the dream) assuming I would be reunited with my luggage. When I reached the boarding area, I waited for a few minutes and realized this wasn’t one of my brighter decisions, so I asked someone how many minutes I had until the bus arrived and boarded so I could go look for my luggage (obviously it hadn’t been reunited with me). I remember the airport being some kind of mashup of JFK, Laguardia, and O'Hare.
